notes.title: FINAL UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39836192/537bc206be1dd8500048d6f86768fa4e2e318763.jpg[/img]
This is just a final quality of life update for the Winning Love by Daylight demo.

So there is no new playable content, but there is still news!

Episode 1+2 has completed it's Prom story arc, and will soon have its very final update before Episode 3 will be released.


Winning Love by Daylight was also nominated for FOUR different awards at the NZGF:Pavs! (The winners are announced on Saturday here: https://www.twitch.tv/nzgamesfest)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39836192/a97aef269e44e3c339c859a833b0132fc84d82f5.png[/img]

You can find much more content from the team that made Winning Love by Daylight at these places:

notes.title: Winning Love by Daylight Version 0.6 out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39836192/09d313646dca6dbe81f4c480a42f9ae1f2633cea.png[/img]

Drama incoming as we now release Version 0.6 and the story starts to get crazy!

Will we find out who the Skeleton King is?

Will you finally be able to ask someone to the Prom?



------------ What's new in V0.6? ------------

- Three main paths for Sunday

- now a total of 21 milestones (Including a new secret milestone)
